findings.location: Goal, second bullet; Increment D, step 3; Increment E
findings.problem: The default bridge invocation disables all tools, but the release check requires successful file, shell and web canaries through that same bridge without --confine as controls. Those controls cannot succeed with the planned default arguments, so the release check cannot pass. The earlier direct-program probes with tools enabled do not resolve this mismatch in the planned bridge release procedure.
findings.suggestion: Define a release procedure with explicit tools-enabled direct-program controls and confined bridge runs, documenting why the controls differ, or revise the default invocation so the specified bridge controls can succeed. State the control validity and release acceptance criteria in the plan.

summary: The planned default disables the tools required by its release-check controls, leaving the completion procedure unsatisfiable.
